an3.57:1.1: Atha kho Vacchagotto paribbājako yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami . . .
an3.57:1.2: pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Vacchagotto paribbājako Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.57:1.3: Sutaṃ me taṃ bho Gotama samaṇo Gotamo evaṃ āha:--
an3.57:1.4: Mayham eva dānaṃ dātabbaṃ na aññesaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ,
an3.57:1.5: mayham eva sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ na aññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ,
an3.57:1.6: mayham eva dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ na aññesaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ,
an3.57:1.7: mayham eva sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ na aññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalan ti.
an3.57:1.8: Ye te bho Gotama evam āhaṃsu samaṇo Gotamo evam āha:--
an3.57:1.13: kacci te bhoto Gotamassa vuttavādino na ca bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaronti. Na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānam āgacchati,
an3.57:1.14: anabbhakkhātukāmā hi mayaṃ bhavantaṃ Gotaman ti.
an3.57:2.5: na me te vuttavādino abbhācikkhanti ca pana maṃ te asatā abhūtena.
an3.57:2.6: Yo kho Vaccha paraṃ dānaṃ dadantaṃ vāreti so tiṇṇaṃ antarāyakaro hoti tiṇṇaṃ pāripanthiko.
an3.57:2.8: Dāyakassa puññantarāyakaro hoti, paṭiggāhakānaṃ lābhantarāyakaro hoti, pubb' eva kho pan' assa attā khato ca hoti upahato ca.
an3.57:2.9: Yo kho Vaccha paraṃ dānaṃ dadantaṃ vāreti so imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ antarāyakaro hoti tiṇṇaṃ pāripanthiko.
an3.57:3.1: Ahaṃ kho pana Vaccha evaṃ vadāmi:-ye
an3.57:3.2: pi te candanikāya vā oḷigalle vā pāṇā tatra pi yo thālidhovanaṃ vā sarāvadhovanaṃ vā chaḍḍeti --
an3.57:3.3: ye tattha pāṇā te yena yāpentū ti -- tatonidānaṃ pāhaṃ Vaccha puññassa āgamaṃ vadāmi,
an3.57:3.5: Api cāhaṃ Vaccha sīlavato dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ vadāmi no tathā dussīle. So ca hoti pañcaṅgavippahīno pañcaṅgasamannāgato.
an3.57:4.2: Kāmacchando pahīno hoti vyāpādo pahīno hoti thīnamiddhaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti vicikicchā pahīnā hoti.
an3.57:5.2: Asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekhena samādhikkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekhena paññakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekhena vimuttikkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti.
an3.57:5.4: Iti pañcaṅgavippahīne pañcaṅgasamannāgate dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ vadāmī ti. 2.
